## Name the catalog your project owns

`scnsim.components` is the built-in catalog. A team that owns reusable
project components should publish a different, clearly named Python module
rather than register factories in global Notebook state. `Library` is the
base class for that custom catalog; it intentionally does not inherit the
built-in factories.

SCNSim derives catalog identity from the concrete subclass and its installed
or source provenance. The author supplies no manual identity string.

```{python}
#| id: create-custom-library
from scnsim import Library


class ResonatorLibrary(Library):
    """Project-specific reusable resonator components."""


components = ResonatorLibrary()
```

## Inspect before adding a factory

Python's native documentation tools are enough to inspect this empty catalog.
It has a stable type and docstring but no custom component factory yet. The
next lesson moves this pattern into the canonical project module and defines
the first factory there.

```{python}
#| id: inspect-custom-library
help(ResonatorLibrary)
help(components)
```
